verses.text: وَ<tajweed class=ham_wasl>ٱ</tajweed><tajweed class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</tajweed><tajweed class=ghunnah>نّ</tajweed>َهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
وَمَا خَلَقَ <tajweed class=ham_wasl>ٱ</tajweed><tajweed class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</tajweed>ذَّكَرَ وَ<tajweed class=ham_wasl>ٱ</tajweed>لْأُ<tajweed class=ikhafa>نث</tajweed>َىٰٓ
فَأَ<tajweed class=ghunnah>مّ</tajweed>َا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَ<tajweed class=ham_wasl>ٱ</tajweed>تَّقَىٰ
وَأَ<tajweed class=ghunnah>مّ</tajweed>َا م<tajweed class=iqlab>َنۢ ب</tajweed>َخِلَ وَ<tajweed class=ham_wasl>ٱ</tajweed>سْتَغْنَىٰ
وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُ<tajweed class=madda_obligatory>ۥٓ</tajweed> إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
وَإِ<tajweed class=ghunnah>نّ</tajweed>َ لَنَا لَلْأَخِرَةَ وَ<tajweed class=ham_wasl>ٱ</tajweed>لْأُولَىٰ
لَا يَصْلَ<tajweed class=madda_normal>ـٰ</tajweed>ه<tajweed class=madda_obligatory>َآ</tajweed> إِلَّا <tajweed class=ham_wasl>ٱ</tajweed>لْأَشْقَى

وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِ<tajweed class=ikhafa>ند</tajweed>َهُ<tajweed class=madda_normal>ۥ</tajweed> م<tajweed class=idgham_ghunnah>ِن ن</tajweed>ِّعْمَ<tajweed class=ikhafa>ةٍ ت</tajweed>ُ<tajweed class=qalaqah>جْ</tajweed>زَىٰٓ

إِلَّا <tajweed class=ham_wasl>ٱ</tajweed><tajweed class=qalaqah>بْ</tajweed>تِغ<tajweed class=madda_obligatory>َا</tajweed>ٓءَ وَ<tajweed class=qalaqah>جْ</tajweed>هِ رَبِّهِ <tajweed class=ham_wasl>ٱ</tajweed>لْأَعْلَىٰ
